About 1.0 MB of folder names and photos. Tips show up here if it takes too long.
Still not loading? Most likely one of these:
  • Weak signal. The page is about 1.0 MB. Give it longer, or switch to Wi-Fi.
  • Opened as a file preview (OneDrive, Files, Drive). Previews don't run the page. Use your bookmarked github.io link in Chrome instead.
  • Chrome is holding a bad copy. Pull down to refresh. If that doesn't fix it, open the same link in a new Incognito tab. If Incognito works, clear Chrome's cache.
  • The last build went wrong. On the PC, open AP Stock Photo Index.html in the AP_STOCK_PHOTOS folder. If it's broken there too, run the .bat again and read what it prints.
